title: OpenAI AgentOS Adds Compliance Auditing, Enterprise Adoption Tops 1,200 Firms
replaces: OpenAI Launches AgentOS Enterprise Platform, Signs 500 Pilot Companies
reason: AgentOS 企业采用已从 500 家试点增至 1,200 家，并新增合规审计模块；原 2026-07-21 条目需刷新
body:
OpenAI said enterprise adoption of its AgentOS platform has more than doubled to 1,200 paying customers, up from 500 pilot companies six weeks earlier. The company also unveiled a built-in compliance auditing module that logs every agent action for regulators in finance and healthcare.

Chief Operating Officer Sarah Linden said the audit trail addresses the single largest barrier to enterprise deployment, and that agent governance has become 'the decisive battleground' of 2026.

title: Brazil Launches National AI Strategy for Public Services
reason: 巴西市场（BR）当前知识库仅 1 篇，属覆盖稀疏区域，建议补充国家级 AI 政策信号
body:
The Brazilian government announced a national AI strategy aimed at deploying autonomous agents across public services, including tax collection and social benefit verification. Officials said the plan prioritizes transparency and human oversight.

The move makes Brazil one of the first Latin American countries to formalize an agent-first public-sector roadmap, expected to shape regional content demand through 2026.

title: LINE Rolls Out On-Device AI Assistant Across Japan
reason: 日本市场（JP）AI 类目覆盖偏少，LINE 是本地高频入口，建议补充
body:
LINE introduced an on-device AI assistant for its 94 million Japanese users, handling scheduling, translation, and commerce queries without sending data to the cloud. The feature targets daily commuter scenarios.

Analysts say the on-device approach addresses Japan's strict privacy expectations and could become a template for regional super-app AI.

title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins for General-Purpose Agents
reason: 欧盟（EU）监管信号当前知识库缺失，对全球化内容供给属关键合规上下文
body:
European regulators began enforcing the AI Act's provisions for general-purpose agents, requiring transparency labels and risk assessments for autonomous systems deployed to EU users.

Compliance officers warn that non-EU providers must still adapt content and disclosures, making the regulation a global reference point for agent governance.

title: Tesla Expands Robotaxi to Three New US Cities
replaces: Tesla Robotaxi Expands to 12 US Cities, Completes 35,000 Rides Daily
reason: Robotaxi 网络已从首发城市扩展至三城，原条目需刷新以保持电动车类目时效
body:
Tesla expanded its robotaxi service to three additional US metropolitan areas, citing a 40% drop in per-mile operating cost since launch. The company said driverless hours surpassed 2 million in July.

The expansion intensifies competition with Waymo and underscores accelerating autonomy adoption in US ride-hailing markets.

title: Korea Ships First Humanoid Robots to Southeast Asia
reason: 韩国（KR）硬件/机器人信号覆盖偏弱，建议补充出口里程碑
body:
A Korean robotics maker shipped its first batch of humanoid workers to manufacturing partners in Southeast Asia, marking the country's entry into the export phase of its robot strategy.

Industry officials said labor-shortage pressures across the region are accelerating adoption timelines ahead of earlier forecasts.

title: Japan Anime Streaming Wars Intensify With AI Dubbing
reason: 日本（JP）娱乐类目仅有动画电影一条，AI 配音是本地高热度话题，建议补充
body:
Japanese streaming platforms deployed AI dubbing that localizes anime into a dozen languages within hours, sharply cutting the lag between domestic and international releases.

Producers say the technology is reshaping global fan engagement and could redefine release strategies for the world's second-largest anime market.
